name: Simple Custom Coming Soon/Maintenance Mode
author: SACHINRAJ CP

sections.description:
Simple Custom Coming Soon/Maintenance Mode is a user-friendly WordPress plugin for creating and customizing a coming soon or maintenance mode page. Whether launching a new site or performing updates, this plugin keeps visitors informed with a professional page—now with even more powerful features in v2.0!

New in Version 2.0:
– Countdown Timer: Set start/end date & time, with real-time countdown and redirect when timer ends.
– Template Options: Switch between Minimal, Professional, and Advanced templates to match your style.
– Live Preview: Instantly see your coming soon page as you customize it from the dashboard.
– Custom CSS/JS: For developers or advanced users to add custom styles and scripts.
– SEO Controls: Set meta title and description for your maintenance page.
– Mobile Responsive: All templates look great on any device.
– Easy Enable/Disable: Control maintenance mode with a single click.

Features include:
– Easy setup with no coding required.
– Customizable messages and styles.
– Countdown timer with optional redirect.
– Multiple templates for different looks.
– Responsive design for all devices.
– Compatible with all themes.

Keep your visitors informed while you work on your website behind the scenes!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/simple-custom-coming-soonmaintenance-mode directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Coming Soon to configure and enable Coming Soon or Maintenance Mode.
sections.faq:
How do I enable the coming soon mode?

Go to Settings > Coming Soon and check the “Enable Coming Soon” option. Save your settings.

Can I customize the page content and style?

Yes! Change title, message, select template, set countdown, and even add custom CSS.

What happens when the timer reaches zero?

The page displays “We’re live!” and (if you set a URL) automatically redirects visitors to your chosen page.

Will the coming soon page affect logged-in users?

No, logged-in administrators can still view the full website as normal.

Is this plugin compatible with any theme?

Yes, Simple Custom Coming Soon/Maintenance Mode works with any WordPress theme.
